meta.northStar: Booked-out regenerative aesthetics practice in Stoneham with a waitlist, then a multi-provider wellness flagship.
meta.diagnosis: Demand recovery + brand confidence + capital sequencing — not competence.

phases.title: Phase 0 — Align
phases.summary: Lock the North Star, capture baseline numbers, and set the weekly scorecard ritual before any rebrand or spend.

items.what: Write and sign the North Star sentence
items.how: Use this exact line (or tighten it once): “Booked-out regenerative aesthetics practice in Stoneham with a waitlist, then a multi-provider wellness flagship.” Put it at the top of your phone notes and this workbook. Acceptance: one sentence you can repeat without hedging.

In one sheet tab named Baseline, enter for the last 90 days: total bookings, revenue, new vs returning patients, Google review count (Boston + Stoneham), top referral source, no-show rate, and % calendar utilization. Acceptance: every cell filled with a real number or “unknown — find by Friday.”

Choose one fixed day/time (example: Monday 8:00 AM, 20 minutes). Open scorecard.html only. Peer comparison is banned during this block. Acceptance: calendar recurring event titled “Angel Face Scorecard” with link to scorecard.html.

On a sticky note at your desk: “If I open a competitor’s feed, close it and open the scorecard.” Your spiral trigger is comparison when soft; this rule separates numbers from ego. Acceptance: note visible at the chair you sit in between patients.

Mark Stoneham as primary in your booking software and marketing calendar. Boston stays open but does not get the first reactivation push. Acceptance: written note in Baseline sheet: “Primary = Stoneham.”

phases.title: Phase 1 — Stabilize bookings
phases.summary: Fill the calendar before any rebrand or big-space spend. Lead with ultrasound + regenerative education, not discount races.

items.how: Export patients last seen in those windows. Columns: name, phone, email, last service, last date, notes. Acceptance: three filtered lists ready to text/email from Stoneham first.

items.what: Send reactivation with ultrasound + regenerative offer
items.how: Message: short, personal, no panic discount. Lead with ultrasound mapping + regenerative consult. Track sent / replied / booked in the sheet. Goal: book from dormant list before chasing cold ads. Acceptance: first 25 Stoneham dormant contacts messaged.

Hours, phone, website, services, photos, and category accuracy. Pin a post about ultrasound-guided safety + natural results. Acceptance: both profiles updated same day; one educational post live on Stoneham.

Topics locked to differentiators: ultrasound safety (3), natural results (2), regenerative / PDGF (2), early tech Alo Clay / Derma Clay (2), education vs deal spa (2), founder story / reviews (1). Draft in one doc; schedule 3/week. Acceptance: 12 captions drafted with before/education angle — no competitor mentions.

After every happy visit: “Who do you know who would want this level of safety and natural results?” Log referrals asked / names given / booked. Acceptance: script on a card at checkout; sheet columns live.
Until utilization target is hit: hold 3 consult slots + 2 treatment blocks daily on Stoneham days. Protect them from random admin. Acceptance: blocks visible on calendar for the next 14 days.

items.what: Publish lead magnet: regenerative consult + ultrasound mapping
items.how: One clear offer on GBP, IG bio, and booking link — not a race-to-bottom discount. Frame as education + safety mapping. Acceptance: offer live in three places with same wording.

items.what: Ask for Google reviews after 5 strong visits
items.how: Text the direct GBP review link the same day while they are happy. Your reviews are a stated differentiator — keep the flywheel moving. Acceptance: 5 asks logged; aim for ≥2 new reviews in 30 days.

Write the number that means “stable enough to touch brand assets.” Example: 4 consecutive weeks at ≥70% Stoneham utilization OR 20% booking lift vs Nov baseline. Acceptance: gate written on scorecard.html notes and Baseline sheet.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Brand without erasure
phases.summary: Rebrand is a phased system, not a hard cutover. Protect Angel Face search visibility until demand recovers.

items.what: Pass the rebrand decision gate before spending on a new name
items.how: Proceed with visual/system refresh only if Phase 1 utilization recovers OR you have written proof the current name blocks premium pricing (lost quotes, patient quotes). Do not hard-delete Angel Face. Acceptance: gate answered Yes/No in writing with evidence.

items.what: Keep Angel Face Injections searchable as legal/DBA
items.how: Legal entity / DBA stays findable. If adding a modern umbrella brand line, treat it as “Brand Line, by Angel Face Injections” for at least 6 months. Acceptance: written naming rule saved in brand notes.

items.what: SEO protect plan: redirects, GBP, Instagram, formerly line
items.how: Checklist: domain redirects/301s if URL changes; GBP name strategy that does not wipe Angel Face overnight; IG handle plan; site/bio “formerly Angel Face” for 6 months; Google search test for “Angel Face Injections” weekly. Acceptance: SEO protect checklist checked item-by-item before any public rename.

items.what: Lock brand voice: safety + regenerative + natural
items.how: Three pillars only (from your recording): education/safety, regenerative medicine, natural results. Ban: deal-spa language, competitor shade, panic discounts. Acceptance: one-page voice doc with Do / Don’t examples.

Logo options, color tokens, typography, before/after photo policy, FAQ (ultrasound, PDGF, natural results). Acceptance: asset checklist with owners and due dates — design files can wait until gate passes.

items.what: Draft patient-facing rename message (if gate passes)
items.how: Email/SMS: what stays the same (you, safety, regenerative care), what changes (look/name line), how to still find Angel Face. Acceptance: draft approved by you before any designer posts.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Offer + ops cash engine
phases.summary: Productize what already sets you apart. Hire only after utilization and cash gates clear.

items.how: Order: injectables core → ultrasound-guided → regenerative (PDGF) → early adopter (Alo Clay / Derma Clay) → facial/laser add-ons later. One page patients and you can follow. Acceptance: ladder printed at consult desk.

items.what: Refresh price card to education/safety positioning
items.how: Price for outcomes + ultrasound/regenerative expertise — not to match deal spas. Note packages that pair consult + mapping. Acceptance: updated card in booking flow and at front desk.
Write the 4-step visit flow with scripts and timing. Attach referral ask + review ask. Acceptance: one-page SOP you can hand a future hire.

items.what: Launch plan for Alo Clay / Derma Clay without distraction
items.how: One landing caption + waitlist form + clinical FAQ. Do not let new tech steal Phase 1 reactivation hours. Acceptance: waitlist live; launch date set after utilization gate.

items.what: Set first hire gate (aesthetician / nurse / PA)
items.how: Hire only after X consecutive weeks at target utilization AND Y cash reserve (deposit + 3 months partial payroll). Write X and Y as numbers. Acceptance: hire gate numbers on scale.html and Baseline sheet.
Must match your bar: knowledgeable, patient, safety-first, natural results. List 5 interview questions and a shadow day plan. Acceptance: role scorecard saved; no posting until hire gate passes.

phases.title: Phase 4 — Space / devices / wellness vision
phases.summary: Bigger space, devices, hyperbaric, facials, lasers — roadmap only until cash and demand clear the gates.

items.how: Require: months of demand above capacity, cash buffer for deposit + buildout + 3 months burn, and Phase 1–3 gates green. Acceptance: criteria sheet with numbers — touring spaces before this is a distraction.

items.what: Device buy order with lease-first rule
items.how: Rank devices by revenue pull-through after utilization proof. Prefer revenue-share or lease before cash buy. Facials/lasers after injectables+regenerative calendar is full. Acceptance: ranked list with buy/lease/skip.

items.what: Wellness roadmap board (not this quarter’s spend)
items.how: Park: facials institution, lasers, hyperbaric, full holistic suite under one roof. Each item needs demand signal + capital source before active. Acceptance: roadmap board with status = Parked / Research / Active — nothing Active without gate.
Future: aestheticians, nurses, PAs — as booked as you. Sequence hires after first hire succeeds for 90 days. Acceptance: org sketch with order of roles, not a hiring spree list.

Monthly: % to operating reserve, % to tax, % to growth fund for space/devices. No growth fund spend until space + device gates pass. Acceptance: three % numbers written and followed for one full month.

scorecard.title: Weekly scorecard
scorecard.rule: Numbers only. No competitor feeds during this block.

metrics.label: Comparison spiral? (Y/N)
metrics.hint: If Y: what pulled you back to the scorecard?
